mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates strong economic activity, which should drive positive S&P 500 returns as corporate earnings are likely to improve.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over a 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate indicates a weakening labor market, which could negatively impact consumer spending and corporate revenues.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate alongside increasing inflation (CPI) suggests tighter monetary conditions, which can negatively impact equity valuations.
failure_condition: If both FEDFUNDS and CPI increase but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns as production expands.
failure_condition: If industrial production growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over a 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts indicate a strong housing market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive equity returns.
failure_condition: If housing starts increase but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate can make borrowing more expensive, potentially slowing down economic growth and negatively impacting equity returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in employment (PAYEMS) alongside low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which can positively impact consumer spending and equity returns.
failure_condition: If both PAYEMS and UNRATE improve but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which should positively impact corporate revenues and equity returns.
failure_condition: If retail sales growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over a 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.
